# Fyso

> Fyso is a platform for building business applications using entities, records, business rules, and automations. Integrate via MCP (Model Context Protocol) or REST API.

## Instructions

- Always use `select_tenant` before any tenant-specific operation.
- Use MCP tools (not REST) when building from an AI agent — MCP handles auth and tenant context automatically.
- REST API base URL: `https://api.fyso.dev/api` — do NOT use tenant subdomains. Tenant isolation is handled via the `X-Tenant-ID` header.
- Every REST API request requires `Authorization` and `X-Tenant-ID` headers.
- Never create entities with fields that duplicate system fields (id, createdAt, updatedAt).
- Use `generate_entity` with `auto_publish: true` for quick prototyping. Use the draft/publish cycle for production.
- Use `create_business_rule` with agent-generated DSL. The `generate_business_rule` tool has been removed.
- For REST API access, prefer platform keys (`fyso_pkey_*`) over admin keys (`fyso_ak_*`) — platform keys enforce RBAC per entity and operation.
- Default tool profile is `core` (~60 tools). Set `FYSO_TOOLS=advanced` for flows, webhooks, secrets, and destructive operations.
- Filter syntax for `query_records`: `"field operator value"` (e.g., `"status = open"`, `"price > 100"`). Compound: `"status = open AND priority = high"`.
- Relations store UUIDs. Use `resolve_depth` (1-2) in `query_records` to auto-resolve nested relations.
- Static sites deploy to `{subdomain}-sites.fyso.dev`. Use `generate_deploy_token` for CI/CD (persistent, reusable).

## Agents Guide (start here if you are an AI agent)

- [Agents Overview](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/agents/overview): What agents can do, integration paths, auth methods summary
- [Authentication](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/agents/authentication): API keys, platform keys, public keys, bot identity, tenant login
- [MCP Quickstart](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/agents/mcp-quickstart): Step-by-step: connect, create entity, records, rules, users, deploy
- [Building a Complete App](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/agents/building-a-site): End-to-end ticket system — data model, rules, RBAC, views, API, deploy, knowledge base
- [Users & RBAC](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/agents/users-and-rbac): Roles, custom roles, entity permissions, row-level filtering, invitations
- [Channel Tools](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/agents/channel-tools): Custom MCP tools, Tool DSL, bot identity, cross-tenant tool execution
- [Embeddings & Semantic Search](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/agents/embeddings): Record embeddings (field-level vectors), grouped embeddings, TTL, Knowledge Base RAG, semantic search via MCP and REST, DSL semantic_search operation, admin stats and reindex
- [Auth for Static Sites](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/agents/static-site-auth): Public keys (fyso_pk_*), dynamic login flow, temporary tokens, complete HTML+JS example
- [MCP vs REST API](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/agents/mcp-vs-rest): When to use each, auth differences, response format comparison, side-by-side examples

## Entities

- [Create Entities](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/entities/create-entity): generate_entity tool, field properties, response format
- [Field Types](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/entities/field-types): text, number, email, date, boolean, select, relation, has_many, file, location
- [Add Fields](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/entities/add-fields): manage_custom_fields tool
- [Publish Entities](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/entities/publish): Draft/published lifecycle, versioning
- [Entity Views](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/entities/views): Filtered projections with independent RBAC

## Records

- [Record CRUD](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/records/crud): create, query, update, delete — filters, pagination, semantic search
- [Filters](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/records/filtering): Operators, compound filters (AND/OR), REST field filters, full-text search
- [Relations](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/records/relations): Relation fields, resolve_depth, has_many, nested resolution

## Business Rules

- [Overview](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/business-rules/overview): Rule types (compute, validate, action, on_query), triggers, lifecycle
- [DSL Reference](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/business-rules/dsl-reference): Formula, conditional, lookup, aggregate, validate, transform, actions
- [Examples](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/business-rules/examples): Invoice calc, stock validation, volume discount, price lookup, text normalization
- [Execution Logs](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/business-rules/execution-logs): get_rule_logs, test_business_rule

## API Reference

- [MCP Tools Reference](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/api/mcp-tools): 10 grouped tools (fyso_data, fyso_schema, fyso_rules, fyso_auth, fyso_views, fyso_knowledge, fyso_deploy, fyso_meta, fyso_agents, fyso_ai) plus fyso_welcome
- [REST API](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/api/rest-api): CRUD endpoints, auth, views API, error codes, curl examples
- [WebSocket](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/api/websocket): Real-time record updates via WebSocket, subscribe/unsubscribe, per-entity toggle
- [Tool Profiles](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/api/tool-profiles): core (~60), advanced (~76), all (~91), per-user override

## Admin

- [Users and Roles](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/admin/users): User management, RBAC, self-service flows, invitations
- [Public Keys](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/admin/anonymous-keys): fyso_pk_* keys with role, TTL, rate limits, CORS, field-level permissions
- [API Management](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/admin/api-management): Platform keys (fyso_pkey_*), permission matrices, role-based REST access
- [Admin API Keys](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/admin/api-keys): fyso_adm_* keys with scopes and audit log
- [Webhooks](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/admin/webhooks): Subscribe to record events, HMAC-SHA256 signatures, retries
- [Knowledge Base](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/admin/knowledge): Document upload (PDF, HTML, URL), semantic search (RAG), stats
- [Flows](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/admin/flows): Automation workflows — triggers, step types, interpolation
- [Secrets](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/admin/secrets): Encrypted storage for use in flows
- [File Storage](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/admin/files): Upload, download, field config, MIME validation
- [Apps Catalog](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/admin/apps): Publish tenant as installable app
- [Import / Export](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/admin/import-export): Metadata export and import as JSON
- [Platform Invitations](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/admin/platform-invitations): Invite new platform users
- [n8n Integration](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/admin/n8n-integration): Community node for n8n workflows
- [AI Agents](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/admin/ai-agents): Built-in agents, runner, sessions, memory, templates, presets, channels
- [Channels](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/admin/channels): Telegram bot, web widget, SSE streaming, channel adapters
- [GDPR Compliance](https://docs.fyso.dev/docs/admin/gdpr): DPA acceptance, session consent, data suppression, audit log
